jp.description: 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種・ナスダック総合が下落して取引を終えた。中東情勢の緊迫化と米国の原油生産減少を受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフ​レや利上げへの懸念が強まった。半導体株の下落も重しとなった。

world.title: New 'computational microscope' simulates DNA packaging at more than ten times previous scale
world.description: The DNA in our cells wraps around proteins called histones to form nucleosomes, which organize into chromatin. This organization helps pack genetic material into the nucleus and influences how easily genes can be read and DNA damage repaired. Understanding how chromatin changes requires studying molecular movements and interactions that are difficult to capture experimentally.

world.title: Nidal Hasan execution at Fort Hood: public firing squad set for December 2026
world.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said convicted Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan’s execution will be carried out publicly by firing squad at the Texas base where he killed 13 people and wounded 32 in 2009. Trump approved his execution earlier this month. The execution will also be livestreamed.

world.title: Key driver of aggressive prostate cancer identified
world.description: Researchers have identified a previously overlooked molecular regulator that helps determine whether prostate tumors remain sensitive to treatment or evolve into a more aggressive, drug-resistant form of the disease. The findings, published this week in Nature, reveal for the first time that a single transfer RNA, or tRNA, can control the identity of prostate cancer cells and influence their response to therapy.
